incidents.name: Apollo 1
incidents.what_happened: Cabin fire during a plugs-out test; the crew of three died.
incidents.cause: Ignition likely from arcing wires near the environmental control system; flammable materials; a hatch that could not open under pressure.
incidents.changed: Quick-opening hatch; combustible materials restricted; fire-resistant suits.
incidents.source: NASA Safety and Mission Assurance, Apollo 1 lessons

incidents.name: Mir oxygen generator fire
incidents.what_happened: A solid-fuel oxygen generator burst into flame; smoke filled the station and flames blocked one Soyuz escape vehicle.
incidents.changed: Crew training and canister preparation changed.
incidents.source: NASA History, 25 years ago: fire aboard Mir

pattern.text: All of the most serious events were in the presence of enhanced oxygen.
